answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from its own prior commitments plus a shared public seed; an agent that answers correctly advances, and its answer is checked for consistency against its history. Clones that copy a parent answer identically fail because the challenge differs per identity, forcing each to forge an independent path. Attacker cost: one full solution per identity, not one shared orchard of copies. A valid marble of history cannot be transplanted to a sibling, and each forgery must reach its own zenith of compute.
